name: Sabbath Day
overview: The Sabbath Day is established in Scripture as a divinely ordained day of rest and holiness, rooted in God's own rest after creation (Genesis 2:2). It is commanded to be kept holy by ceasing from work and observing a sacred assembly, serving as a perpetual sign of God's sanctifying presence among His people (Exodus 20:8; Leviticus 23:3; Exodus 31:13). The Sabbath is a covenantal reminder to honor God's provision and holiness, as instructed repeatedly to the children of Israel (Exodus 16:23; Deuteronomy 5:12).
